Reverse the river.

1 / 2eras explored

Before 1900 — the river carries water toward Lake Michigan.

Why reverse a river?

Protect the drinking water. Chicago’s river once carried sewage toward Lake Michigan, the city’s water supply.

In 1900, the new Sanitary and Ship Canal pulled the current away from the lake. Pollution went downstream; wastewater treatment remained essential.
